inheritance: The 230-unit union binds 23365f2f6; subsequent pointer/window changes have 30 focused unit checks and a real Electron background/window-deactivation regression, with current Web/Test types. Main08fa97bf3 adds only disjoint RSI files. Family geometry/stream assertions retain their prior candidate; pointer handlers are verified separately. Exact source deltas and all failures remain recorded.
broaderGate: Full Harness CI previously failed at Agent Dev audit on old reports and existing performance limits; migration evidence preserves it. This node has explicit current task gates, not a repository-wide release verdict.
